size.$description: Theme lexilink (B2 Ledger): comfortable density, square corners, Archivo and Geist Mono. Colours per mode in lexilink.dark.json and lexilink.light.json.

radius.$description: The ledger has no rounded corner: lexilink's --radius is 0, and its globals.css derives sm/md/lg as max(0, radius - n) and xl as radius + 4px. pill stays round (radios, switches).

display.$description: Archivo's width axis does the hierarchy (lexilink sets weight and font-stretch per role)
